purpose: Human-readable terminal-style log format for the construction demo.
principles: Use single-line bracket log entries: [time] [actor] [kind] message.
Append tool and skill results inline with an arrow: message → result.
Show each tool call as exactly one visible completed row; never split request and response into two rows.
Use full actor display names without fixed-width padding.
Allow compact natural wrapping when a line is too long; wrapped continuations start at the same left edge without hanging indent.
Avoid tree indentation and multi-line results inside the narrow event stream.
Use progress bars only for batch-level operations such as creating agents and splitting tasks.
Progress events with the same label update one visible status row instead of appending repeated rows.
Make TOOL and SKILL visually scannable without requiring the viewer to understand internal system names.
Use demo vocabulary such as subtask, region, foreman, worker, tool, and skill.

time.note: Relative time is for pacing only; exact timestamps are not important in the demo.

actor.note: Use full display names with no right-padding in the visible log line.

normalLog.description: Single-line event for planning, assignment, progress, synchronization, and completion.

labels.WARN: Recoverable problem that leads to repair.

examples: [T+002.10] [Foreman-03] [TASK] group C assigned · workers 041-060 · target 486 subtasks

toolLog.description: Single-line event: one bracketed tool call with inline result.

states.TOOL▶: One completed tool call with input and result shown inline.
states.TOOL✕: Tool call found a recoverable issue; result explains the issue inline.

examples: [T+001.08] [ProjectManager] [TOOL▶] Read Blueprint · input: xini.json → 95,151 blocks · bounds x[-60,30] z[6,148] · 427ms
[T+002.74] [Foreman-03] [TOOL▶] Split Region · input: group=C · axis=x/z · max=50 blocks → 486 subtasks ready · 281ms
[T+003.91] [Worker-047] [TOOL▶] Run Script · input: build_c_014.js → 48 blocks placed · 182ms
[T+004.16] [Worker-052] [TOOL✕] Verify Region · input: subtask D-021 → failed · 2 missing · 1 wrong

skillLog.description: Single-line event for learning, publishing, broadcasting, and using skills, with inline result.

states.SKILL◆: A new reusable skill has been learned or improved.
states.SKILL↗: A skill is published or broadcast to downstream agents.
states.SKILL▶: A worker starts using a skill.

examples: [T+008.50] [ProjectManager] [SKILL◆] Learned Build Region v1 · source: 128 completed subtasks · 17 repairs → reusable region-build pattern ready
[T+008.92] [ProjectManager] [SKILL↗] Published Build Region v1 · target: 5 foremen → skill available for regional execution
[T+009.31] [Foreman-03] [SKILL↗] Broadcast Build Region v1 · target: workers 041-060 → 20 workers updated
[T+010.04] [Worker-047] [SKILL▶] Use Build Region v1 · input: subtask C-089 · 46 target blocks → completed from learned pattern · verified

progressBars.description: Render progress bars only when a viewer can name the batch being completed. Do not attach progress to scanning, material profile, heartbeat, repair, skill-learning, or ordinary status logs.
progressBars.rendering: Coalesce by progress.label within a stage. The visible row is reused and its bar grows as new progress events arrive.
recommendedUses: PM split into 5 logical Foreman region packets
Foreman region split into subtask boards
